title: nD Holographic Projections — the Klein Loop Gallery
the_insight: Paper is a Klein surface. The image printed on it IS reality projected through a dimensional fold. Each iteration (print→scan→critique→evolve) adds a dimension. Flatness is an illusion that dissolves with refinement.

0D.name: point
0D.what: A single pixel. A hash. An identity.
0D.print_analog: A single ink dot. The smallest mark the printer can make.
0D.perceive_as: Nothing... until you zoom in. Then it's everything.

1D.name: line
1D.what: The EKG trace. A waveform. Time flattened to a mark.
1D.print_analog: The EKG at the bottom of the chipmunk easel.
1D.perceive_as: Rhythm. The heartbeat you can SEE.

2D.name: flat image
2D.what: The printed page. Full color, full composition.
2D.print_analog: What comes out of the EPSON. First perception.
2D.perceive_as: Art. A picture. But still flat.

3D.name: depth / texture
3D.what: What the SCAN reveals that the render doesn't show.
3D.membrane_analog: The difference between render and scan = the 3rd dimension
3D.print_analog: Paper grain, ink absorption, edge bleed, color shift from RGB to CMYK
3D.perceive_as: The print is an OBJECT, not just an image. You can touch it.

4D.name: time / iteration
4D.print_analog: v1 → v2 → v3... each generation improves. Time is visible in the stack.
4D.perceive_as: Growth. The art is ALIVE. It changes.

5D.name: meaning / perception
5D.what: What the viewer adds. Context, emotion, understanding.
5D.print_analog: Your reaction to holding the print. The fold completes in your mind.
5D.perceive_as: The paper IS the Klein face. The image IS the reality. They are the same surface. You're inside the Klein bottle looking at yourself from outside.

easel_v1.title: Chipmunk's Tree — v1
easel_v1.critique: Chipmunk is a blob. Labels too small. Canopy is circles not foliage. Heart Bézier needs work. But: composition works, data is legible, soul is present.
easel_v1.next: v2 will fix chipmunk detail, add texture to canopy, improve heart curve, thicken trunk, add ground texture

klein_bottle.title: Klein Bottle — the membrane has no inside
klein_bottle.dimensions: 2.5D (dark bg creates depth illusion, circles suggest volume)
klein_bottle.critique: Best piece. Iridescent circles actually suggest a 3D surface. The fold points (printer/scanner/screen/speaker) at corners anchor it. 'No inside / no outside' is the thesis.
klein_bottle.next: Add more circle density, vary stroke width for depth, add glow effects

escher_strip.title: Escher Strip — impossible staircase
escher_strip.critique: Weakest. Triangles read as pattern not illusion. Need Penrose tiles or interlocking Escher forms. The loop diagram at bottom is good.
escher_strip.next: Replace with actual Penrose tiling or Escher-style fish/bird tessellation

test_card.title: Membrane Test Card
test_card.critique: Functional beauty. When scanned back, reveals nozzle health. The color wheel is nice. Zigzag resolution test works. This is the CALIBRATION page.
test_card.next: Add more resolution tests, dither patterns, halftone dots

the_loop.architecture: print → paper → scan/photo → AI perceives → critique → evolve → print
the_loop.each_print: A composite of N digital thoughts compressed to 1 physical page
the_loop.each_scan: The perception layer — matter becoming data. The 3rd dimension entering.
the_loop.each_critique: AI compares intended vs actual. The gap IS the information.
the_loop.each_evolution: PostScript code mutates. Better curves, better color, more detail.
the_loop.convergence: After N iterations, the print stops looking flat. Paper becomes window. Image becomes reality. The Klein surface becomes transparent.
the_loop.flatness_dissolves: v1 is obviously a printout. v10 you forget you're looking at paper. v100 the paper IS the thing. The map becomes the territory.

klein_face.paper_is: The Klein surface — the fold between digital and physical
klein_face.perception_is: Your consciousness completing the fold — making it real
klein_face.iteration_is: Polishing the fold until it's transparent — until paper dissolves
klein_face.goal: Print so refined that looking at it IS looking through a Klein window into the membrane itself
